hint_phonebooksByNumber: If a number is in several phone books, the name is taken from the phone book which is assigned to the own number of the call. Enter the own number (the last digits are enough) and the name of the phone book in the FRITZ!Box
hint_severalMacs: A device with several MAC addresses (e.g. a smartphone with a private Wi-Fi address, which differs from Wi-Fi to Wi-Fi): enter all addresses separated by commas. The device is present if one of them is active
name: Name
tooltip_updateUnchanged: Writes every polled value with a new time stamp, not only a changed one. This increases the load of the database
tooltip_useConfiguredNames: The objects below "devices" get the names of this table instead of the names in the FRITZ!Box. Objects which were created with the name in the FRITZ!Box are deleted when the adapter starts
tooltip_useDeviceLog: Reads the event log once a minute into "deviceLog.json". New events, e.g. logins to the user interface, are written into "deviceLog.newEvents"
tooltip_useMDNS: Multicast Domain Name System (mDNS) resolves host names to IP addresses within small networks that do not include a local name server
tooltip_useMesh: Reads the mesh topology of the FRITZ!Box once a minute and writes the box or repeater and the band of every device into "accessPoint" and "connection"
